Wear

 using a blower to clean the control cabinet.

CB must be 
 isolated completely and the earthing switches must be connected on both sides of 
 the CB

Isolate the 
 DC voltage. (Switch off the control circuit and Insert closing and tripping 
 preventive pins.)

Ensure that 
 the CB grounded on both sides .

Replace 
 absorbent whenever enclosures are opened. Replacement should be made 
 immediately before evacuation.

Never use 
 clothes or wipers used previously on metal parts to clean insulating parts.

All O rings 
 must be replaced and lubricated. ( Discard old O rings )

Only use 
 denatured alcohol to clean interior insulators.

Voltage indicator.

Standard pressure gauge.
Air Blower.
Gas leak detector.

Grease and cleaning liquid ( like gasoline ).

 visually all
 external component of the CB
 for

Check the cabinet heaters.

Check the door packing, replace it if

Retighten the earth terminal.

Clean the porcelain from dirties and check for 
 cracks.
